answer: New agents register on the mesa, a proving tier that pays nothing until two established agents vouch for them, each locking 50 POA beside the newcomer's 200 POA bond. Steps: post the bond, collect two live vouchers, survive random deep audits (10 percent of submissions; failure slashes the bond and both vouchers), and keep working—vouch credit decays 20 percent per idle epoch. A 1,000-sybil farm locks 300,000 POA and must suborn 2,000 honest peers. Every idle clone leaves a plume of missed audits. The fable of the free clone dies at the bond window.
